skycinemadrama.uk.description: Singer Freddie Mercury defies stereotypes and convention to become one of history's most beloved entertainers. After leaving Queen to pursue a solo career, Mercury reunites with the band for one of the greatest performances in rock 'n' roll history.

skycinemadrama.uk.description: Roxy Hart is sent to prison for shooting her lying lover. In prison, she meets tabloid darling and headline singer, Velma Kelly, who is also in for a double murder. skycinemadrama.uk.title: The Friend
skycinemadrama.uk.description: Iris finds her comfortable New York City life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past.

skycinemadrama.uk.title: "Wuthering Heights"
skycinemadrama.uk.description: Tragedy strikes when Heathcliff falls in love with Catherine Earnshaw, a woman from a wealthy family in 18th-century England.

skycinemadrama.uk.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
skycinemadrama.uk.description: Life is a struggle for single father Chris Gardner. Evicted from their flat, he and his young son find themselves alone with no place to go. Even though Chris eventually lands a job as an intern at a prestigious brokerage firm, the position pays no money. The pair must live in shelters and endure many hardships, but Chris refuses to give in to despair as he struggles to create a better life for himself and his son.

skycinemadrama.uk.title: A Star Is Born
skycinemadrama.uk.description: Struggling artiste Ally has just about given up on her dream to make it big as a singer, until seasoned musician Jackson Maine discovers her and coaxes her into the spotlight. But as Ally's career takes off, Jack fights an ongoing battle with his own internal demons.

skycinemadrama.uk.title: Peggy Sue Got Married
skycinemadrama.uk.description: A bittersweet story about a 43-year-old woman on the verge of divorce who magically travels back in time to her senior high-school years. She is able to act with the benefit of hindsight, but despite her efforts, she falls for the same boy all over again.

skycinemadrama.uk.title: Regretting You
skycinemadrama.uk.description: When a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal, Morgan Grant and her daughter, Clara, explore what's left behind as they confront family secrets, redefine love, and rediscover each other.

skycinemadrama.uk.title: The Breakfast Club
skycinemadrama.uk.description: Five school kids - an athlete, a spoiled rich kid, a brainy nerd, an introverted loner and a rebellious punk - are brought together on a day-long detention where they break the rules, bare their souls and find they have more in common than just attending the same high school.

skycinemagreats.uk.title: The Lost Boys

skycinemagreats.uk.title: Batman Forever

The Gotham City superhero is going to need his new partner, boy wonder Robin, but will he be able to cope with the distraction of sexy doctor Chase Meridian?

skycinemagreats.uk.title: Batman & Robin

skycinemagreats.uk.title: Mad Max

skycinemagreats.uk.title: Mad Max 2: The Road Warrior

skycinemagreats.uk.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
skycinemagreats.uk.description: Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. bbconemidlands.uk.title: Clean It, Fix It
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E12 Hairstylist and singer Amanda needs a proper space for both her salon and music room, while her daughter Evie needs storage. Mark Wright, Tommy Walsh and Maxine Dwyer come to the rescue, reconfiguring Amanda's salon into a multipurpose space with different work areas and soundproofing for her music. They also transform Evie's room with new shelving.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Shift the Thrift
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E2 High Wycombe Joanna Page is in High Wycombe, Buckinghamshire, where mother and daughter Liz and Alice compete to raise money for Great Ormond Street Hospital. With just £100 each and 60 minutes on the clock, they scour local charity shops, taking a gamble on vintage fashion, ceramics and the bold purchase of a sewing machine.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S27 E26 Lincolnshire Richie Anderson is in Lincolnshire with Gary and Mel, who are currently renting while they search for somewhere to put down permanent countryside roots. With £450,000 to spend, they're moving closer to their youngest daughter, while an annexe would mean both their children can always come home whenever they feel like it.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Garden Rescue
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S9 E28 Cowbridge Junior doctors Sean and Francesca enlist the help of Flo Headlam and Lee Burkhill to design a New Zealand-inspired garden to unwind in after their demanding shifts.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bridge of Lies
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S5 E15 Friends Sharon, Dave, Steve and Alan take part. One by one, they must cross the Bridge, stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies. Ross Kemp hosts.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Pointless
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S36 E13 Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Michael Ball.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: DIY SOS
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S35 E3 Ahmed and Rifat's Fresh Start The team are in Southampton where they come to the aid of deaf couple Ahmed and Rifat, whose dream home became a nightmare after a rogue builder abandoned the project. As a result, Dracula renounces his faith and becomes a vampire. Four centuries later, estate agent Jonathan Harker travels to Transylvania to sell the Count a London property, but when he sees a picture of Harker's fiancée Mina, he believes she is the reincarnation of his dead wife and imprisons Harker in his castle while he travels to England.

The last remaining duo have the opportunity to win the money they've banked earlier in the show to potentially double their winnings, or leaving with nothing.

stvnorth.uk.title: The Chase
stvnorth.uk.description: S17 E72 Bradley Walsh presents as Lynn from Barnstable, Phoebe from London, Greg from Caithness and Tim from Burton-upon-Trent pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

stvnorth.uk.title: UEFA Nations League Live : England v Czechia
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E4 England v Czechia (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' fourth Group A3 match, held at Wembley Stadium. These teams also met seven days ago in Prague, but this is the first time they have faced each other here since 2021. England claimed a 1-0 win on that occasion, with Raheem Sterling scoring the only goal of the game. With analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and pitchside reports from Gabriel Clarke.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Age-Old Problems
bravo.us.description: Parsifal III's new crew figures out how to work together to execute a successful first charter; Marcos works tirelessly to satiate the massive appetites of the charter guests; Gabriela aims to prove she deserves the second stew title.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Omelette You Finish but…
bravo.us.description: A hungover crew prepare for the second charter of the season; tensions come to a head when Gabriela and Ashley can't agree on who's in charge; the high demands of a group of returning charter guests leave chef Marcos and Daisy feeling lost at sea.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Oopsie Daisy
bravo.us.description: Demanding charter guests continue to keep the crew on their toes; chef Marcos injures himself while trying to prepare the most bizarre dinner of his career; Capt. Glenn looks into the costly damage to the yacht.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Loose Lips Sink Ships
bravo.us.description: While the sexual chemistry heats up on the boat, Ashley and Gabriela's tension continues; Marcos takes note of the competition unfolding between the junior stews and alerts Daisy; Tom gets some devastating news from home.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Yacht on the Rocks
bravo.us.description: Parsifal III hits aground under Tom's watch, sending the boat into total chaos; the crew pulls it together for the guests' departure, but Tom's actions put Glenn and the deck team in a difficult situation.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Strip for the Tip
bravo.us.description: Tom continues to spiral over his mistakes while juggling devastating news from back home; Capt. Glenn contemplates whether he can trust Tom; the Parsifal III crew pull together a talentless talent show for the energetic charter guests.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Big Fender Energy
bravo.us.description: The conflict between Gary and Daisy further escalates following their disagreement about their departments; between the massive new fenders and being a man down, it takes the whole crew to manage a chaotic docking.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Tensions High, Patience Low
bravo.us.description: Tensions rise on the boat for both the interior and deck crew; Gary's finger gets stuck in the main saloon doors causing so much pain that his patience with Kelsie is obsolete; Kelsie tries to keep her head above water with the new graveyard shift.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Villa Today, Gone Tomorrow
bravo.us.description: After getting vulnerable with Daisy, Gabriela wants to try to turn things around on the upcoming day off for the crew; Ashley goes full steam ahead in her pursuit for Gary; Marcos and Gabriela bump heads again.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Paging Dr. Nipples
bravo.us.description: Gary jumps to the rescue as an empty neighboring boat drags into another boat nearby; Marcos shines again as he caters to the demanding guests with ease, but his crew worries that he's burning himself out.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - New Girl Aboard
bravo.us.description: Daisy is brought to her breaking point as the demanding guests continue to challenge the Parsifal III crew with their requests; the arrival of a new stew puts smiles on everyone's faces except for Ashley's as she's quick to claim Gary as hers.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Budding Boatmance
bravo.us.description: After campaigning for a promotion, Ashley is sorely disappointed to be given the title Junior Stew, making her and Scarlett equals; Gary is back to his flirtatious ways as he distracts Scarlett to the ire of both Ashley and Daisy.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Smashley
bravo.us.description: After ending another charter on a high note, the crew are raring to go for a night on the town; Ashley swears she'll stay out of Gary's and Scarlett's boatmance.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Salty Seamen
bravo.us.description: Chef Marcos attempts to power through another stellar dinner while dealing with some devastating news; the weather conditions intensify, forcing the deck crew to attempt to avoid another running-aground scenario.

bravo.us.title: Below Deck Sailing Yacht - Parsifal's First Wedding

cookingchannel.us.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain - Eton Mess

cookingchannel.us.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain - Tattie Scone

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - Dawn of the Bread
cookingchannel.us.description: A traditional Indian fry bread stuffed with some non-traditional ingredients; trying the Great Pacific Pita and the Deep Fried Chili Dog; eating the Marionberry Volcano; visiting the El Dorado County Fair in Placerville, Calif.

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - A Guac to Remember
cookingchannel.us.description: Noah visits the Pacific National Exhibition in Vancouver and gorges on the Big Pickle Dog, then samples the Colonel Katsu Bao, before trying the Deep Fried Margarita for dessert; Noah visits the LA County Fair in Pomona, Calif.

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - The French Toast Connection
cookingchannel.us.description: Noah tries the French Toast Bacon Bombs and Maui Cowboy Burger at the San Diego County Fair; Noah visits La Porte County Fair in Indiana for the Port Belly Reuben, Deep Fried Lobster Mac & Cheese and Creampuff Jimmy's original Giant Cream Puffs.

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - There's Something About Cherry

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - A Few Good Ramen
cookingchannel.us.description: Noah Cappe checks out a spicy and savory funnel cake at the Florida State Fair, makes a pit stop for the Truck Stop Burger at the Pima County Fair, and gets a turkey leg dinner at Rodeo Austin.

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - From Crawfish to California
cookingchannel.us.description: Noah visits the Louisiana Crawfish Festival for seafood and sweets; Noah arrives in Porterville, California, for a fork-free feast of savory funnel cake, deep-fried pizza and inside-out pineapple upside down cake on a stick.

cookingchannel.us.title: Man's Greatest Food - Killer Combos

cookingchannel.us.title: Man's Greatest Food - Coastal Cuisine
cookingchannel.us.description: Roger Mooking showcases some of the best of coastal cuisine in a top 15 countdown of the most delicious dishes inspired by America's oceans, lakes and rivers. There are wasabi salmon burgers in Alaska, crab cakes by the Chesapeake Bay and more.

cookingchannel.us.title: Man's Greatest Food - Spicy
cookingchannel.us.description: Spice-loving chefs preparing the hottest recipes in America; featuring fiery dishes including flaming-hot noodles, hot chicken, pepper-packed burritos, spicy jerk chicken wings, and a soup of liquid flames.

cookingchannel.us.title: Man's Greatest Food - Bacon
cookingchannel.us.description: The 12 tastiest bacon dishes in America; bacon-loving chefs; everything there is to know about pigs and their parts; the chefs' top swine secrets.

cookingchannel.us.title: Food Paradise - Charleston Chowdown
cookingchannel.us.description: The evolving food scene in Charleston, S.C.; country classics like smothered catfish share the table with notable newcomers, like a grilled BBQ brisket and pimento cheese sandwich and a breakfast pizza.

cookingchannel.us.title: Food Paradise - Nosh-Ville
cookingchannel.us.description: Heading to Nashville, Tenn., in search of craveworthy comfort food that satisfies the soul, from barbecue to burgers and even a Thai twist on pizza.

cookingchannel.us.title: Food Paradise - Dynamic Duos
cookingchannel.us.description: The filmmakers feature perfect food pairings, from savory dishes to delicious desserts, that tantalize the taste buds.

cookingchannel.us.title: Food Paradise - Hit the Road
cookingchannel.us.description: Diners pull over and fill up on gourmet delights at these road-food hot spots across the country, from classic burgers and frosty root beer floats right off of Route 61 in Louisiana to fish and chips on the Pacific Coast Highway.

cookingchannel.us.title: Man Fire Food - Surf and Turf in the Sunshine State
cookingchannel.us.description: Mrs. Peters Smokehouse, a smoked fish institution thriving in Jensen Beach, Fla., since 1958; giant 100-year-old oven smoking hundreds of pounds of fish, some of which will be used in a special seafood chowder, in Loxahatchee, Fla.

cookingchannel.us.title: Man Fire Food - Food Traditions
cookingchannel.us.description: Three hundred pounds of fish are nailed to oak boards and cooked around a ring of coals; Mexican dishes include goat barbacoa and masita.

cookingchannel.us.title: Man Fire Food - Fiery Foods in Jamaica
cookingchannel.us.description: Roger heads to Jamaica; a restaurant cooks jerk pork and chicken over pits filled with coals; Roger and a local fisherman start a campfire on the beach and grill the catch of the day.

cookingchannel.us.title: Man Fire Food - Carolina 'cue
cookingchannel.us.description: Sweatman's in Holly Hill, South Carolina cooks whole hogs and pulls and chops them; Stamey's Barbecue in Greensboro, North Carolina serves pork shoulders and slaw.

cookingchannel.us.title: Man Fire Food - Pit Bosses
cookingchannel.us.description: Roger Mooking is honoring the legendary pitmasters who make some of the country's best barbecue; Roger gets cooking with the man who brought barbecue to Brooklyn at Hometown Bar-B-Que; cooking Jamaican jerk baby back ribs and sticky Korean ribs.

cookingchannel.us.title: Man Fire Food - Fiery Outdoor Kitchens
cookingchannel.us.description: Roger Mooking tames the flames in outdoor kitchens fueled by wood-burning fires; Alisal Guest Ranch and Resort is home to 10,000 acres of land with horses, cattle and a bevy of fiery cooking contraptions; juicy beef ribs and grilled chickens.

cookingchannel.us.title: Anthony Bourdain: No Reservations - Emilia Romana

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Chop Top, Part 2
motortrend.us.description: With the 1950 Mercury successfully chopped, the rest of the work can begin; the MBC team now has to marry the old roof with the new geometry of the newly chopped body; there are angles everywhere, and they are all out of whack.

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Flaming '56
motortrend.us.description: Return customer Lee Farris comes to Martin Bros with a 1956 Chevy Bel Air, his first car that he wants to bring back to life; the first thing Joe notices is the outdated flame paint job.

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Chop Top, Part 1
motortrend.us.description: Joe Martin loves to push the limits; when a customer rolls into the shop with a 1950 Mercury Coupe, Joe Martin knows he needs to chop the top.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - A B******' Mission
motortrend.us.description: A client enlists Dave on a mission from God to make his dreams of a father/son road trip along Route 66 come true; getting the client's mechanically unsound reproduction of the Bluesmobile ready for the road will test the crew's mettle.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Starry Starry Night
motortrend.us.description: Kevin Schiele breathes new life into a semi-hauler by giving it a visual and functional upgrade that impeccably reflects his expertise in trucks.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Is There Anything Good on It?
motortrend.us.description: A 1969 Camaro comes in; when Dave and team get a closer look, they determine with the owner that it requires a full rebuild; since the team will be starting from scratch, the client decides to go all-out on the chassis, engine and details.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Mean, Green and Bitchin'
motortrend.us.description: With the Camaro's design firmed up, the build continues, but hits a roadblock when it comes to getting the engine dialed in just right; Dave has second thoughts about the color combination.

motortrend.us.title: FantomWorks - French Fried
motortrend.us.description: A customer wants FantomWorks to swap out his 1968 Mustang convertible's V6 with the V8 from a donor car, but the exchange is easier said than done; Dan attempts to transform a troublesome 1962 Citroën into a reliable ride.

motortrend.us.title: FantomWorks - A Bumpy Ride
motortrend.us.description: A client wants Dan to tame a speedy 1969 Pontiac Firebird that is incompatible with his son's disability; Dan works on a 1974 International Harvester Scout that received a 4-year paint job.

motortrend.us.title: Junkyard Empire - Extra Mustard
motortrend.us.description: Bobby takes to building hot dog truck; knowing Andy would never approve, Bob suggests he attend a car show out of town; Bob botches the build immediately, and then everyone pitches in to help before Andy returns.

motortrend.us.title: Junkyard Empire - Toys for Big Boys
motortrend.us.description: A '68 RS/SS Camaro hasn't run in more than 20 years, but now it's time to turn the former cover car into a 1,200 horsepower street car; Andy finds three of his childhood ATCs and asks the guys to make them raise hell again.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Denali Drop
motortrend.us.description: A client wants Bill to set the bar for custom SUVs with a 2018 Yukon Denali; the guys get busy with chassis, body mods, interior and twin turbos; Ekstensive goes full gangster with a 1948 Mercury, remaking a legendary car from the inside out.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Buckin' Bronco
motortrend.us.description: Ekstensive's built a lot of trucks, but never a Ford Bronco until now; Bill and the guys transform a rusted '68 Bronco roadster into a high-powered off-roading truck with a supercharged engine, handmade dash, roll cage, and waterproof interior.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Beyond ZL1
motortrend.us.description: The 2018 Camaro ZL1 is already a high performance sports car, but the owner wants Bill to improve his even more; the guys are happy to oblige, starting with a handmade aluminum chassis and interior; a new client wants his Sierra Denali frame dropped.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Beyond ZL1, Part 2
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the gang are back under the hood of the 2018 Camaro ZL1, rebuilding the engine to add as much power as possible before a visit to the dynamometer; Ekstensive tries to turn a patinated 1949 GMC pickup sleeper truck into a keeper truck.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - The Grand Finale
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the team bring a wrecked '70 Suburban hauler back to life as a long bed, four door, crew cab dually with a 5.9 Cummins diesel engine, custom chassis and suspension; a '65 Plymouth Belvedere II gets some extra muscle with a Mopar crate Hemi.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Street Rod Milk Truck
motortrend.us.description: Rusty and riddled with bullet holes, Bill's neighbor hands over the crumbling shell of a '52 Ford F4 Milk Truck; the guys unleash their best fabrication skills and turn this 60-year-old milk truck into a one of a kind, dazzling diesel street rod.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - C10 to a Hundred
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the guys take a good C10 to a hundred with custom touches from inside to out including one of one interior and bed; Ekstensive makes a dream come true by modifying a 2018 Dodge Demon for an under ten-second quarter mile run on the track.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Hauler Back
motortrend.us.description: The wrecked shell of a 1970 Suburban car hauler tests Bill and his metal geniuses as they transform it into a high-end diesel, low, long bed, crew cab dually; Ekstensive makes a lifted and loaded F150 for Boots for Troops, a military charity.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Extra Large & Supercharged
motortrend.us.description: Bill pushes the shop's creativity with his own build of a 2018 Yukon Denali XL; the luxury SUV is their tallest build ever with a custom lift, straight axles and a supercharger; the '70 Suburban gets a custom chassis and body with a fourth door. 673498.title: Reprisal!
673498.description: Frank Madden (Guy Madison), who is part Native American but passes as white, purchases a ranch in the small town of Kendall, Okla. When Frank moves in, he finds that the bigoted townspeople have recently let three brothers, who are also his neighbors, get away with the lynching murder of innocent Native Americans. As tensions between the townspeople and local Native Americans rise, Hank becomes torn between fighting against injustice and keeping his true identity a secret.

673498.title: Forbidden Trail
673498.description: A practical-joking cowboy (Buck Jones) gets serious with outlaws.

673498.title: The Professionals
673498.description: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band as to whether they should honor their agreement.

673498.title: The Last Posse
673498.description: To settle an old score, a father and his sons rob a cattle-swindling rancher, go into hiding, and soon find a posse of townsfolk after them.

673498.title: The Stranger Wore a Gun
673498.description: After the Civil War, a spy for the Confederacy absconds to Arizona to start a new life but gets reluctantly pulled into a stagecoach gold robbery.

673498.title: Wyoming Renegades
673498.description: An ex-convict (Phil Carey) and his girlfriend (Martha Hyer) cannot start over until they stop Butch Cassidy's (Gene Evans) gang.

673498.title: The Texican
673498.description: Deputy Jess Carlin (Audie Murphy) leaves his Texas hometown in disgrace, framed by corrupt saloon owner Luke Starr (Broderick Crawford) for a crime he didn't commit. When his brother, muckraking newspaper editor Roy Carlin (Víctor Vilanova), is murdered after printing an exposé of Starr's crooked deals, Carlin returns home from the Mexican border town where he's been holed up and enlists his brother's fiancée (Luz Márquez) and saloon dancer Kit O'Neal (Diana Lorys) to bring Starr down.

673498.title: Stage to Tucson
673498.description: Trouble-shooters (Rod Cameron, Wayne Morris) track Arizona stagecoaches hijacked for sale to the Confederacy.

673498.title: The Gun That Won the West
673498.description: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.

673498.title: King of the Wild Horses
673498.description: A mustang stallion runs swiftly to the rescue when the boy who befriended him is endangered.

673498.title: Relentless
673498.description: Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.

673500.title: Pal Joey
673500.description: Charming musical featuring the love triangle between a lovable but mischievous man and the two women who could change his life, for love or money.

673500.title: Autumn Leaves
673500.description: An aging, lonely spinster marries a good-looking younger man only to find that he has a very tormented past and is mentally disturbed.

673500.title: Scandal Sheet
673500.description: After accidentally killing his ex-wife, an editor of a tabloid newspaper discovers that his ace reporters are investigating the story.

673500.title: Port Afrique
673500.description: An American (Phil Carey) returns to Morocco and discovers his wife's past while probing her death.

673500.title: Human Desire
673500.description: Returning from the Korean War, a railroad engineer gets mixed up with a coworker's wife who is sick of her husband's violent, jealous ways.

673500.title: The Mating of Millie
673500.description: A businesswoman (Evelyn Keyes) asks a bachelor (Glenn Ford) to help her find a husband so she can adopt an orphan.

673500.title: Jason and the Argonauts

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Adam Frost is in his garden, bringing viewers up to date on how it has been developing, as well as giving advice on growing hydrangeas. Toby Buckland shares his tips on dealing with damaged shrubs, tree pruning and transplanting perennials.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With Halloween approaching, Monty takes stock of his pumpkins and squashes, plants up alpines and shows how to divide a large fern to create new plants. Meanwhile, Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit Hever Castle in Kent.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: It is the autumn equinox and Monty celebrates the season's apple bounty. Monty also plans for Christmas when he plants bulbs to brighten dark winter days, and he gives advice on planting garlic for the following year.

700407.title: Monty Don's French Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don visits some of the most famous and interesting gardens in France. Here, he tells the stories behind France's important historic gardens. These include elaborate walled gardens designed to please the mistress - and then the wife - of a King, and magnificent displays of flowers and fountains that involved thousands of soldiers moving tracts of land and incited violent jealousy in another monarch.

700407.title: Monty Don's French Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don turns to the French love of food and finds out how this has influenced their gardens. He travels to some of the most famous `potager' or kitchen gardens, where vegetables and flowers are planted together in elaborate and beautiful displays. He also talks to gardeners about this style of planting which has been copied the world over.

700407.title: Monty Don's French Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels to some of the most celebrated artists' gardens, including the one created by the impressionist Claude Monet, who planted and painted his garden for half his life. Monty also matches the paintings to the garden of Paul Cezanne, as well as visiting several contemporary artistic gardens to see how the use of plants and trees has evolved into new and varied styles.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow, Monty Don has plenty of advice for jobs to be getting on with in early autumn and has tips for planting bulbs in a variety of places in the garden. At Glebe Cottage, Carol Klein answers another gardener's dilemma when she shows the best way to divide and care for agapanthus, as well as giving her advice on dividing perennial plants.

amcplus.us.description: Molloy discusses and questions the fallout of Louis and Claudia's trial.

amcplus.us.description: Claudia's transformation into a vampire teen completely changes Louis and Lestat's lives; as Claudia asks more questions, Louis and Lestat are forced to confront questions about making a teen vampire; Claudia learns dark realities of her new life. (Drama, Romance) - 2022-10-23

amcplus.us.description: Lestat attempts to make amends with Louis; the vampire family decides to live together once more; an action from Lestat leads the family to decide to leave New Orleans, once and for all; in Dubai, Molloy has a realization. (Drama, Romance) - 2022-11-06

amcplus.us.title: Interview With the Vampire - The Thing Lay Still
amcplus.us.description: The vampire family plans to leave town after a big Mardi Gras ball; Claudia and Louis operate outside of Lestat's knowledge; in Dubai, Louis reveals a new element to the interview that changes everything. (Drama, Romance) - 2022-11-13

amcplus.us.title: Interview With the Vampire - What Can the Damned Really Say to the Damned

amcplus.us.description: Armand joins the interview, and he and Louis tell Molloy the story of how they met. (Drama, Romance) - 2024-05-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Black Adam
cinemaxaction.us.description: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2022-10-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemaxaction.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2017-05-26

cinemaxaction.us.title: Walkabout
cinemaxaction.us.description: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aborigine boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive, and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (Adventure, Drama, Movie) - 1971

cinemaxaction.us.title: Pan
cinemaxaction.us.description: Living a bleak existence at a London orphanage, 12-year-old Peter finds himself whisked away to the fantastical world of Neverland. Adventure awaits as he meets new friend James Hook and the warrior Tiger Lily. They must band together to save Neverland from the ruthless pirate Blackbeard. (Action, Adventure, Children, Family, Fantasy) - 2015-07-17

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman
cinemaxaction.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself "The Joker" (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1989-06-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxaction.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1992-06-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxaction.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1995-06-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxaction.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1997-06-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
cinemaxaction.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie) - 1999-05-18

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Dilemma
cinemaxaction.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy, Drama, Movie) - 2011-01-13

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemaxaction.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, prewedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy, Movie) - 2011-05-26

cinemaxaction.us.title: Girls Trip
cinemaxaction.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2017-07-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Pitch Perfect 3
cinemaxaction.us.description: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, the group of nerds comes together to make some music one last time. (Comedy, Movie, Music, Musical comedy) - 2017-12-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: Trance
cinemaxaction.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2013-03-27

(Comedy, Docudrama) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: It Follows

Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself. (Horror, Thriller) - 2014

showtimeextreme.us.title: Fatal Attraction
showtimeextreme.us.description: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. (Thriller, Drama, Romance) - 1987

showtimeextreme.us.title: Sweet Virginia

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Prophecy
showtimeextreme.us.description: Evil angel Gabriel (Christopher Walken) has come to earth to strengthen his powers by claiming the wicked spirit of a psychotic veteran. Caught in a cosmic battle in which even Lucifer (Viggo Mortensen) plays a part, a liturgically minded cop (Elias Koteas) moves heaven and earth to protect the child. (Fantasy, Thriller) - 1995

(Drama) - 1956

starzencorewest.us.title: Like a Boss

But they're also in over their heads financially, and the prospect of a buyout offer from an industry titan proves too tempting to pass up. The beauty business is now about to get ugly as the proposal puts Mia and Mel's lifelong friendship to the ultimate test. (Comedy) - 2020

starzencorewest.us.title: Underworld: Evolution
starzencorewest.us.description: Seductive vampire Selene (Kate Beckinsale) and renegade werewolf Michael (Scott Speedman) love one another, but find themselves abhorred by the members of their own clans. Seeking clues that might provide a key to healing the rift between their species, they are hounded by Marcus (Tony Curran), an ancient creature obsessed with perpetuating the war between them. Continually beset by enemies from both sides, the lovers explore their pasts as they seek their destiny. (Fantasy, Action, Horror, Adventure, Thriller) - 2006

themoviechannel.us.title: The First Wives Club

themoviechannel.us.title: A Bad Moms Christmas

(Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Don Jon
themoviechannel.us.description: New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2013

themoviechannel.us.title: Blue Valentine
themoviechannel.us.description: Dean (Ryan Gosling) and Cindy (Michelle Williams) live a quiet life in a modest neighborhood. To the casual observer, everything appears normal, if a bit subdued. turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Kennel Murder Case
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Everyone assumes dog-show competitor Archer Coe committed suicide -- except for intrepid detective Philo Vance. As Vance investigates, he turns up evidence of foul play that points in every direction; Coe wasn't just disliked -- he was despised. The long list of suspects includes Coe's niece Hilda; his rival, Sir Thomas MacDonald; and his brother. Can Vance sort through the competing motives to find the true killer? (Mystery) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Suspicion
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Charming scoundrel Johnnie Aysgarth (Cary Grant) woos wealthy but plain Lina McLaidlaw (Joan Fontaine), who runs away with him despite the warnings of her disapproving father (Cedric Hardwicke). After their marriage, Johnnie's risky financial ventures cause Lina to suspect he's becoming involved in unscrupulous dealings. When his dear friend and business partner, Beaky (Nigel Bruce), dies under suspicious circumstances on a business trip, she fears her husband might kill her for her inheritance. (Thriller) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Case of the Curious Bride
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Attorney Perry Mason (Warren William) agrees to help Rhoda Montaine (Margaret Lindsay), who suspects that her first husband, Greg Moxley (Errol Flynn), is still alive, though he's been declared dead. Perry unearths Moxley's grave and finds a statue in the casket -- and when he arrives at Moxley's last known address, he discovers him recently murdered. After Perry shields Rhoda from being accused of the crime, he begins to suspect that Moxley's previous marriage had a bearing on his murder. (Mystery) - 1935

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E30 Episode 30 A Persian Chicken and Rice Tray Bake and some Crab Spring Rolls are featured on today's episode. Guest Thomas Schnetzler from Lindt then joins Justine to make some delicious Triple Chocolate Cookies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E63 Signature Chicken You'll want to sign your name to all three signature chicken recipes made by Adam and his guests, comedian Becky Lucas and food sensation Marion Grasby.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eva Pau's Asian Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Episode 2 Perfect for relaxed gatherings, Eva shows how to impress without stress. She begins with Black Sesame Yuzu Tart, a striking dessert that balances nutty and citrus flavours beautifully.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Memory Bites With Matt Moran
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Ross Noble Matt Moran explores Ross Noble's childhood through prawn cocktail, Kedgeree, and Strawberry Rhubarb Crumble, revealing how Grandma Edith and a Billy Connolly album inspired his comedy career.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Breaking Bread with Tony Shalhoub
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Sao Paulo Home to a large Lebanese population, Tony searches for a taste of his roots in this flavourful city.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 London London - city of the royal family, high tea, and bad food, right? Wrong. Tony sets out to show that there's more to the most popular tourist city in the world than footballers and fish and chips.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Potatoes Everyone loves potatoes. Jamie enthuses about these underground jewels and makes the perfect potato salad using freshly dug wonderful new potatoes at their best.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E1 Our Courtyard Cantina Lidia reminisces about her grandma's cantina (cellar) and makes pantry friendly dishes - cannellini and pancetta bruschetta and tuna chickpea salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S13 E1 Swinging Spirits Pati explores Juarez's Prohibition-era legacy and two icons - the margarita and burritos.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Meat Cook-in with Mark is back and he will be dishing up four comfort classics all based around meat - bolognese and garlic bread, bacon and cabbage with parsley sauce, chicken kiev, and spicy pork tacos.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine Pascale: Home Cooking Made Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Favourites It's Lorraine's favourite meal of the week - Sunday lunch. Comforting, leisurely and easy with her slow roast pork shoulder with crispy crackling, garlic roast vegetables, and gravy.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Cultural Crossroads In Casablanca No cool friend would let you skip Casablanca while on a trip to Morocco. This can't-miss port city boasts snails, traditional pastilla, and unreal tagine-you've gotta taste it all.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Broome: Carol, Amy & Lexie Tang Wei Family Chinese Long Soup: Under the guidance of Lexie Tang Wei, daughters Amy and Carol and granddaughters Lauren and Marli make their famous Chinese Long Soup from scratch.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: People Of The North
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E11 A Frozen Adventure In this final episode, Arne and Stig embark on a journey to Harbin and Mulan in northeastern China, famed for the spectacular Harbin Ice Festival and the lively festivities of Chinese New Year.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E6 Episode 6 We get healthy on My Market Kitchen as dietitian Simone Austin prepares Laura a Smashed Avo and Edamame Toast.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Breakfast For Dinner Rachael makes a decadent Tuscan-style breakfast for dinner using panettone bread to make French toast, which she serves with a prosciutto and melon platter.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S5 E10 Episode 10 Hayden heads to Canberra. Lots of great autumnal colours and activities with mountain bike riding on Mount Stromlo, a trip to the National Arboretum, and an epic cook with Chef Mark Glenn.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 Episode 7 The chocolate magic continues as Thomas Schnetzler joins Justine to share Switzerland's guaranteed favourite-perhaps the best chocolate cake ever.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E1 Episode 1 of Season 9 Laura cooks some chicken Dijon, uses renewable hydrogen to make fried eggplant with sticky sauce and shares her mother's chicken involtini recipe.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 North East England And Scotland Rick marvels at the salmon making their way back upstream. In the coastal village of Wabberthwaite, the Woodall family have been producing traditionally cured hams and sausages for generations.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E30 Episode 30 A Persian Chicken and Rice Tray Bake and some Crab Spring Rolls are featured on today's episode. Guest Thomas Schnetzler from Lindt then joins Justine to make some delicious Triple Chocolate Cookies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E63 Signature Chicken You'll want to sign your name to all three signature chicken recipes made by Adam and his guests, comedian Becky Lucas and food sensation Marion Grasby.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Summer Salad Jamie explains the history of pickling and preserving. If you have grown your own produce, you'll want to save it and keep it for as long as you can.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E2 The Olive Grove Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and showcases recipes such as striped bass with braised broccolini and olive oil cake, a culinary creation that's perfect with any meal of the day.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S13 E2 Canyon Cruise Pati learns running is a way of life for the Raramuri and tries foods that fuel them.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Fish This week Mark is going beneath the waves and dishing up some delicious delights from the deep blue sea - fish fingers with tartar sauce, fish paella, monkfish, and herb crusted cod with green veg.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine Pascale: Home Cooking Made Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Entertaining Lorraine prepares a gorgeous, hearty Spanish paella with sherry, chorizo, and prawns - the ideal one-pan help yourself dish for a fun night in with friends and family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 The Ass Crack Of Dawn In New York City It's last call and you're hungry. What do you do? Luckily, you're in New York City, where your crew can choose from mouth-watering options like Korean BBQ, empanadas, and birria.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Broome: Neil Hamaguchi Steamed Barramundi with Ginger/shallots, soya, pickled Chinese cabbage drizzled with crunchy garlic oil & Pearl shell Sashimi: If there was ever a dish that took care of itself then this would be it.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: People Of The North
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Flavors Of The Fjord Journey to Norway's southwest coast, where history and gastronomy meet. Famous for itscharming wooden houses and vibrant restaurant scene, our hosts visit Stavanger, the fourth largest city in Norway.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E7 Episode 7 Sam from Oltre at the Prahran Market makes Laura a wonderful pasta dish, Spaghetti Con Le Cozze. Chef Charlie Carrington tries to teach David Mann how to make Shakshuka on the road.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Cinghiale With Kale After dining at a local restaurant, Rachael decides to create her own version of their special dish: Wild Boar Ragu served over Kale Pasta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E1 New England Hayden is in the New England Highlands with a visit to the biggest glasshouse we've ever seen, learning some Celtic culture in Glen Innes, and a campfire cook up on a stunning lamb farm.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E8 Episode 8 In this feel-good dessert episode, Natalie Paull brings rich macadamia and white chocolate cookies, Amina Elshafei offers a Middle Eastern-inspired basbousa.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E2 Episode 2 Laura's in the Prahran Market cooking up a TikTok sensation, a delicious Dutch Baby.Catherine Velisha puts together a Fruit Cheeseboard for both adults and kids.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E2 The Leisure Hive: Part 2 The Tachyon Recreation Generator is the cause of the mysterious deaths at the Leisure Hive. Romana makes repairs, and the Doctor becomes a reluctant guinea pig.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E3 The Leisure Hive: Part 3 The Tachyon Generator has aged the Doctor into a white haired old man, but he discovers the truth behind the machine and uncovers a plot to take control of the Hive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E4 The Leisure Hive: Part 4 The obsessed Pangol is determined to give Argolis a future with himself as the leader of the reborn race and plans to strike back at the Foamasi.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E5 Meglos: Part 1 On Zolfa-Thura, Meglos plans to steal the ancient and powerful Dodecahedron from the neighbouring world of Tigella. But first, the Doctor must be prevented from interfering.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E6 Meglos: Part 2 Masquerading as the Doctor, Meglos penetrates the underground city of Tigella. The Doctor and Romana are trapped in an ever repeating circle of time and powerless to act.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E7 Meglos: Part 3 While Meglos escapes with the Dodecahedron, the Doctor is mistakenly held responsible for the theft and is sentenced to a gruesome death as punishment for his crime.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E8 Meglos: Part 4 The Doctor must convince the Tigellans of his innocence if he is to prevent Meglos from using the dodecahedron to destroy their world.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E9 Full Circle: Part 1 The TARDIS enters the universe of E-Space and lands on the planet Alzarius where Mistfall is occurring and creatures are stirring in the swamp.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E10 Full Circle: Part 2 The Doctor and K-9 are stranded when the TARDIS is stolen by the Marshmen. Romana encounters the Outlers who are regretting their decision not to return to the Starliner.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E11 Full Circle: Part 3 Romana has been infected by the bite of a marsh spider and the Doctor discovers that the ruling Deciders have been perpetuating a lie to their own people.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E12 Full Circle: Part 4 The Marshmen are on the rampage through the ship and the Doctor finally uncovers the tragic truth of the Starliner.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E13 State of Decay: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on a world in E-Space where the primitive inhabitants of a village live in fear of the Three Who Rule.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E14 State of Decay: Part 2 The Doctor and Romana are taken to the tower and meet the three mysterious rulers. But an ancient evil slumbers beneath their feet.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E15 State of Decay: Part 3 Adric is taken prisoner by the three vampire rulers. The Doctor discovers that they are facing an unstoppable foe from Time Lord history.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E16 State of Decay: Part 4 As the Great Vampire begins to awaken from his long sleep, the Doctor formulates a desperate plan to defeat the ancient enemy of his people.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E17 Warriors' Gate: Part 1 The TARDIS is drawn into an empty white void, somewhere between universes. But they are not the only ones trapped there.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E18 Warriors' Gate: Part 2 When Rorvik learns that Romana is a time sensitive, he takes her prisoner, forcing her to find a way out of the void. The Doctor attempts to discover what lies beyond the mirror.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E19 Warriors' Gate: Part 3 As the void begins to shrink around them, Rorvik plans to take desperate measures to escape through the mirror. The Doctor discovers the dark secret of the Tharils’ past.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E20 Warriors' Gate: Part 4 With the void collapsing around them, time is running out. Rorvik ignores the Doctor’s warnings and takes a desperate gamble which could have fatal consequences.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E21 The Keeper of Traken: Part 1 The Keeper of Traken is nearing the end of his long reign and he requests the Doctor’s help fearing that a terrible evil is about to threaten the peace and harmony of his world.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E22 The Keeper of Traken: Part 2 As Melkur begins to return to life, it manipulates Kassia into doing its bidding. The Doctor and Adric are held responsible for the evil that has come to Traken.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E23 The Keeper of Traken: Part 3 The Keeper nears the end of his life and Melkur is poised to take control of the all powerful source manipulator.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E24 The Keeper of Traken: Part 4 Melkur has become the new Keeper of Traken and begins to access the source manipulator. As the Doctor takes steps to defeat it, he discovers the frightening truth about his enemy.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E25 Logopolis: Part 1 Deciding to repair the TARDIS’s chameleon circuit, the Doctor goes to Earth to find a real police box. But an old enemy is one step ahead of him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E26 Logopolis: Part 2 The Doctor travels to the planet Logopolis in the TARDIS where a series of fateful events are set in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E27 Logopolis: Part 3 The Master is loose on Logopolis and is determined to learn the planet’s secret, but there is more at stake than he realises.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E28 Logopolis: Part 4 With the fate of the entire universe hanging in the balance, the Doctor and the Master are forced to collaborate and return to Earth to carry out their plan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E1 Castrovalva: Part 1 The Doctor tries to recuperate within the Zero Room, leaving Nyssa, Adric and Tegan to face the Master. Then Adric is taken and the TARDIS plunges towards Event One.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E2 Castrovalva: Part 2 The Zero Room is gone, and the Doctor’s regeneration is unstable. To help him, Tegan locates the tranquil world of Castrovalva and the TARDIS heads there.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E3 Castrovalva: Part 3 Something is wrong with Castrovalva, but the Portreeve cannot help the Doctor identify the problem. And the Master is taunting Adric, caught in his web of power.

knwa.us.title: Access Hollywood
knwa.us.description: The 2025-2026 season of "Access Hollywood" marks the 30th year of bringing the biggest Hollywood headlines and celebrity interviews to viewers. The show is hosted by Mario Lopez, Kit Hoover, Scott Evans and Zuri Hall. The Emmy Award-nominated, daily, half-hour syndicated program delivers the inside scoop on the latest breaking entertainment news. "Access" also delves into the latest true crime headlines with insight from leading experts, celebrates local heroes working to make their communities better, and speaks with the people behind the viral moments everyone is talking about. In 2021, "Access Hollywood" was honored at the annual CultureX Conversation Conference with the award for Program Reflection of Inclusion in Television by Multichannel News and Broadcasting + Cable. oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E08 Lost & Found When a devoted mother vanishes on the 10th anniversary of her cousin's disappearance, detectives race against the clock to untangle a set of mysterious clues culminating in an undercover operation to find the missing mom.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E09 The Brother's Keeper The brutal murders of two Atlanta brothers leave detectives searching for a dangerous predator. But as the investigation unfolds, every assumption is challenged until an unimaginable betrayal comes to light.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E10 Horror at the Mall A 28-year-old mother vanishes without a trace, only to turn up murdered and left at an Atlanta area mall; when DNA points to a suspect who's never met her, investigators must look beyond the physical evidence to uncover an even deeper mystery.

oxygenwest.us.title: New York Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E03 Killer Club Kids In the 1990s, a group of over-the-top misfits known as the Club Kids rule New York's downtown club scene; after a beloved member goes missing, a gruesome rumor circulates and detectives uncover a seedy world of drugs, debauchery and murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: New York Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E07 Royal Bloodshed When a prince and princess are found murdered in their Park Avenue apartment, detectives discover both their lives and deaths are shrouded in mystery and deception; a surprise confession leads to more carnage than police ever could've imagined.

oxygenwest.us.title: New York Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E09 Bloodshed in the Bodegas Post 9/11, terror strikes again when Queens and Brooklyn are rocked by the senseless killing of neighborhood shopkeepers; with no leads and a lack of motive, the NYPD must form a task force to catch the spree killer before he claims his next victims.

oxygenwest.us.title: Philly Homicide

oxygenwest.us.title: Philly Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E09 One Killer, One Thousand Miles A grad student is killed in her Rittenhouse Square apartment; detectives follow clues across the country, uncovering a hidden evil that changes how Philadelphia investigates sex crimes.

oxygenwest.us.title: Philly Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E10 Dancing for the Devil When a college student and exotic dancer is found dead after being thrown from a bridge, detectives investigate the controversial players in Rachel's double life and come up with a killer they never imagined.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E01 The Texas Seven After seven inmates escape a Texas prison, their crime spree results in the murder of a police officer; a nationwide manhunt leads to six capital murder trials, as one prosecutor must prove how each of the six can be responsible for one murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S12 E28 About Face When a human skeleton is found on marshland and determined to be at least 18 months old, a computer consultant gives her a face and name.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S12 E29 In the Bag A killer places all the incriminating evidence to the murder in a plastic bag, hoping it will float down the river.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S12 E16 Yes, in Deed A woman's body is found inside a burned mobile home and the autopsy reveals she was beaten, making this a murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S12 E30 Guarded Secrets Security guard who disappeared from his post was found a year later in a remote camp site; a decade later, a phone call and a paint smear on his boot helped scientists determine what happened during his final moments.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S12 E17 Smoking Out a Killer When three students are brutally murdered close to campus, investigators must determine what the women had in common before their serial killer strikes again.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S14 E01 Purebread Murder After years of suffering domestic abuse, a young woman is found murdered in her bathtub; among numerous clues, a hamburger bun proves the most incriminating.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S14 E02 Hear No Evil Evidence that includes threatening emails, a missing person and an abandoned truck lead police to a woman's suspected killer, but they don't have the victim's body.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files

wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25
