truehistory.us.title: King Arthur: History and Legend - The Origins of King Arthur
truehistory.us.description: Studying images of the Arthurian legend and their relationship to historical reality; tracing the history of post-Roman Britain; the large-scale invasions of the Anglo-Saxons; evidence that a single individual rose up to lead his people. (Books & literature) - 2015-03-06

truehistory.us.title: King Arthur: History and Legend - An Arthur-Like Figure in Cornwall
truehistory.us.description: Investigating archeological and historical evidence that supports the existence of an Arthur-like figure in early Britain; studying the site of Cadbury Castle, the center of operations of a leader who thwarted the Saxons; the supposed tomb of Arthur. (Books & literature) - 2015-03-06

truehistory.us.title: King Arthur: History and Legend - King Arthur in the Latin Chronicles
truehistory.us.description: Exploring some of the most significant early witnesses to the Arthurian legend; studying accounts of Arthur's exploits and death in Latin texts and the Welsh Annales Cambriae; how texts from the 11th and 12th century C.E. embellished the legend. (Books & literature) - 2015-03-06

truehistory.us.title: King Arthur: History and Legend - King Arthur in Wales - The Mabinogion
truehistory.us.description: How Arthur became a cultural touchstone in early Welsh history; key references to the Arthurian saga in the Black Book of Carmarthen and the Triads of the Island of Britain; the portrayal of Arthur in the tales of the Mabinogion. (Books & literature) - 2015-03-06

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sisters, Stew, and Sass
tastemadetravel.us.description: Roasted tomatoes rice with cumin and oregano; chicken livers with chipotle caramelized onions; avocado and panela cheese salad.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Mayan League of Their Own
tastemadetravel.us.description: Amazonas softball team; sweet potato and meat salpicon; pepita, egg and chaya tamales; roasted tomato and habanero salsa.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Yucatán Meats
tastemadetravel.us.description: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Los Mariachis
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Welcome to Guadalajara
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Exploring the Night Markets of Bangalore
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke heads to the city of Bangalore in southern India; he visits MTR, one of the oldest coffee houses in the city; he learns how to make idli; he meets up with a friend to explore the night markets.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - The Coffee Culture of Coimbatore
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke learns about Kongunadu cuisine in Coimbatore, partners with a family in Thrissur to create an authentic delicacy and learns about India's rich coffee culture.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Discovering the Mystical Kerala Backwaters
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits the port city of Kochi, Kerala, where he checks out the iconic Chinese fishing nets, does laundry the old-fashioned way and cooks a famous dish. He leaves the city to witness the state's backwaters and local fishing techniques.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat - Searching for the Best Pizza in Rome, Italy
tastemadetravel.us.description: Chef Giorgio Locatelli takes Fred to Rome in search of the city's most exciting eats. Sublime pasta, fluffy gnocchi and the world's best pizza all delicious but affordable.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat - The Master Pasta Maker of Puglia, Italy
tastemadetravel.us.description: TV and radio host Dermot O'Leary takes Fred Sirieix to Puglia in Italy's deep South to his favourite restaurants showcasing simple but sublime cucina povera or poor man's cooking.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat - The Floating Restaurant of Devon, United Kingdom
tastemadetravel.us.description: Fred travels to South Devon with chef and restaurateur Angela Hartnett. From Angela's all-time favourite restaurant in Dartmouth to an incredible floating café on the River Exe.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - BBQ, Pizza, & Noodles in Nashville
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie visits Nashville for smoky BBQ Pork, hand-pulled noodles, a luxe burger, and hand-pulled noodles.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Salmon Tacos, Meatballs, & Perogies in Las Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie dazzles in Las Vegas where he enjoys crunchy salmon skin tacos, an homage to after-school snacks, and the dish that put Martha Stewart on the map.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Picasso Pasta, Custard Cups & Cowboy Steaks in New Jersey
tastemadetravel.us.description: Grab your fork and join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through New Jersey's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From silky custard cups to pasta Picasso to giant pizza slices, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Smothered Pork Chops, Ramen & Fried Flounder in Charleston
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pull up a seat and join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through Charleston, South Carolina's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From coastal soul to Lowcountry classics, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Chicken Fried Steak, BBQ & Biscuits in San Antonio
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ready for Texas-sized flavors? Join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through San Antonio's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From authentic Tex-Mex to Hill Country BBQ, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Fish Tacos, Bacon Burgers & Bucatini in San Francisco
tastemadetravel.us.description: Let's dig in. Join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through San Francisco's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From classic diner bites to fusion feasts to waterfront fish tacos, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Guayabera World
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Jalisco Classics
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tucson: Gateway to Sonora
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Hermosillo Food Crawl
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati spends a day in Sonora's capital, Hermosillo, visiting some of the city's best culinary destinations. From gigantic burritos at Doña Guille to Sonoran hot dogs, Pati experiences all Hermosillo's food scene has to offer.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Blessing and The Benefit
tastemadetravel.us.description: On the coast in Bahía Kino, local fishermen catch giant sea scallops. Then, in the mountain town of Matape, Nere, one of Sonora's few female butchers shares her wisdom with Pati.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Carne Asada with La Familia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It's an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Flour Power
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati tours one of Hermosillo's oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery. In her kitchen, Pati shares her take on a classic Sonoran recipe - a carne con chile burrito.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sonoran Family Favorites
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Legends of the Sonoran Sea
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Super Sonoran
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cooking for the Crew
tastemadetravel.us.description: As Pati travels with her TV production crew through Mexico, they stop at a hacienda outside of Hermosillo where Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast in the rustic outdoor kitchen - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Hacienda Ranch Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Sipping Gin in Sapa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-14

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E08 Final Reckoning: Shaneless Shane takes shadiness to a whole new level when he stirs up drama in the house and then later on the playing field; Faith is dealt shocking news that changes how she views her tryst with Kyle.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E09 Final Reckoning: Bro-ing Pains A torturous elimination shocks the players and sends the losers to an angry Redemption House; an unforgettable double cross promises to shake up the game.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E10 Final Reckoning: Redemption House of Cards When one team pulls the Double Cross, a player takes politicking to a whole new level when he tries to flirt his way to safety; a disgusting meal awaits the players at the "Dunking For Dinner" challenge.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E11 Final Reckoning: You're the Worst Tensions boil over between Cara Maria and the Lavender Ladies, leaving Marie in the middle of her friends and her vendetta partner; at the "Sky Bridge" challenge, the players must rebuild both their trust and a perilous rope bridge.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E12 Final Reckoning: Unhappy Days One player is shaken when their partner hurls an unforgivable insult at them; the players find themselves locked up and puzzled at the "Caged In challenge"; at the "Tread Lightly Elimination," a shocking match-up has tremendous impact.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E13 Final Reckoning: The People vs. Johnny Bananas A plot by the Lavender Ladies and Team Young Buck to topple Johnny Bananas spins wildly out of control, resulting in the most shocking elimination of the season so far.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E14 Final Reckoning: Lavender Is the New Black After the results of the last wild elimination, the Lavender Ladies' loyalty toward one another is put to the test; Sylvia headbutts Marie...really.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E15 Final Reckoning: Wheel of Fortune Bananas and Tony struggle with being the odd men out in the game; twists in the Double Cross leads to a twisted plan that blows up in one team's face; two results of the elimination round send shock waves through the game.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E16 Final Reckoning: The Leftovers A debaucherous night ends in total chaos as simmering tensions throughout the game finally boil over; the players face off in "Hit List," where their trivia skills are put to the test.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E17 Final Reckoning: Scandal Rumors and gossip become one team's secret weapon when their backs are against the wall; surprising outcomes at the "Heads Will Roll" challenge have lasting implications on the game.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E18 Final Reckoning: It's Always Sunny in South Africa The Redemption House erupts when enemies come face to face; a season-long grudge match is finally settled when two power-house teams must battle for survival; players compete in the "Rolling Thunder" challenge.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E19 Final Reckoning: The Walking Dead Alliances are dissolved as every team fights to earn their way into the finals; Paulie and Cara Maria's season-long flirtation turns into something more; TJ reveals a shocking twist regarding the Final Challenge.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E20 Final Reckoning: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? The Challengers come face to face with their ultimate Final Reckoning as the four remaining teams of Vendettas compete to take home the million-dollar prize in a grueling, epic, and completely shocking Final Challenge.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E21 Final Reckoning Reunion, Part 1 After facing one of the most intense seasons in series history, the "Final Reckoning" cast reunites with their vendettas one last time to rehash this season's biggest backstabs, blowups, hookups and more.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E22 Final Reckoning Reunion, Part 2 The drama continues in the surprise-packed reunion as the cast reveals behind-the-scenes secrets and the biggest vendetta from this season reaches its final reckoning.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E01 Double Agents: License to Killer Kam Contestants battle against each other for their share of a $1,000,000 prize; former champions find themselves in danger as a cutthroat plan emerges to take them down.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E02 Double Agents: Dive Another Day The Mission: Ice Spy Challenge puts agents in freezing temperatures; a romance blooms; an agent plots against her partner.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E03 Double Agents: Enemy of the State Fessy's exposed lies about the secret vote cause concern within his alliance; agents must wrestle against each other on top of a speeding truck during an explosive "Mission: Road Kill" challenge.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E04 Double Agents: Duplicity Fessy's lies about the secret vote cause concern within his alliance; agents battle each other on top of a speeding truck in a Mission: Road Kill challenge; an emotional agent pushes two other players past their breaking point.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E05 Double Agents: Skyfall After one agent is deactivated, TJ institutes a security breach, shaking up partnerships; the mission is Agent Down, in which agents must overcome their fears of heights.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E06 Double Agents: From Theresa With Love When rumors spread about Theresa's loyalties, she quickly becomes public enemy number one; a pair of agents find their partnership struggling during Mission: Smuggle Run; the new double agent's lack of transparency raises red flags.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E07 Double Agents: Die Another Jay A target is placed on a strong pair of agents; Devin presses an agent's buttons; agents must face their fears while hanging off of a helicopter.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E08 Double Agents: A Muddy Matter Aneesa and Olympian Lolo Jones get into a heated exchange during a muddy competition; CT starts to worry about his partnership with Big T; Amber M becomes suspicious of one of her closest friends in the game.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E09 Double Agents: Lady Vengeance One agent is called out after trying to appease both her alliance and her new group of friends; T.J. forces the agents to participate in his favorite game; old grudges resurface as two rivals go head-to-head.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E10 Double Agents: A Clockwork Amber Two agents' attraction to one another heats up; Lolo and Nam's relationship grows cold; after a major win during Mission: Black Sand Ops, the double agents struggle to get on the same page.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E11 Double Agents: An Inconvenient Goof CT fears he may be locked out of getting a Gold Skull and decides to train Big T for battle; one agent's unforgettable performance shocks everyone during the high-flying Mission: Air Lift; TJ drops a bombshell.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S36 E12 Double Agents: Tinker, Tailer, Bunny, Spy The ramifications of TJ's twist sends shockwaves through Headquarters; one agent becomes public enemy number one after a controversial game move; an injury causes a major setback for one player.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S36 E25 The Veteran's Special House Project: Adaptation & Accessibility Matt DeWitt's disability doesn't limit his cycling passion; ADA-approved and Energy Star-rated homes; how a couple's accessible home allowed them to start a family; touchless faucets and toilets; an ADA-compliant shower; an automatic door opener.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S36 E26 The Veteran's Special House Project: A Home for Matt & Cat Roger, Tom and Norm build a greenhouse; locals help out at the DeWitt project; Kevin meets a vet in Florida; Norm makes a rustic table and a closet.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S16 E24 Reface Fireplace; Kitchen Faucet Mark teaches apprentice Krysten how to reface a granite fireplace; Jenn gives some tips on starting an organic garden; Richard helps a homeowner replace her kitchen faucet when she realizes her shutoff valve is broken.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S16 E25 Drafty Door; Clean Paintbrushes Tom uses multiple techniques to make a drafty door weathertight; Mauro demonstrates the most effective way to clean a paintbrush; Roger and Jenn test out a variety of battery-operated lawn tools.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S17 E03 Stone Walkway; Rustic Headboard Mark installs a front walkway using natural stone; Mauro explains the uses and techniques for different types of painter's tape; Tom and Kevin build a headboard using rustic barn board.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Kelli Campbell - Goodnow

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : Great Britain's Deer
waypointtv.us.description: Navigating the complex issues of deer management, Dan Cabela travels between Scotland and England to learn how land managers balance conservation with wild food harvesting.

waypointtv.us.description: S09 E06 We listen to guides and anglers on how they attempt to hook into the migrating tarpon that pass through PCB's beautiful beach waters each summer. It's a lesson in humility, respect and yes, luck.

McCarthy and friends put on grueling garage workouts that are the talk of the neighborhood.

classica.us.title: Schubert -- Rondo D. 951
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmete sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich der Kammermusik. Auf dem Programm standen unter anderem Felix Mendelssohns Klaviertrio Nr. 1 in d-Moll, Op. 49 und Franz Schuberts Rondo in A-Dur, D. 951.

classica.us.title: The Unanswered Ives
classica.us.description: Charles Ives ist ein Mann der Dissonanzen - und das in fast allen Bereichen seines Lebens. Seit seiner Kindheit gilt seine Liebe dem Spiel mit der Musik. Doch Charles wurde zu einer Zeit geboren, als man klassische Musiker für Memmen hielt.

classica.us.title: Bach - Sonate Nr. 6 BWV 1019
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Enrico Pace und der Violinist Frank Peter Zimmermann spielen Bachs sechste Sonate.

classica.us.title: Dvořák - Sinfonie Nr. 8 in G-Dur, op. 88
classica.us.description: Anlässlich des 30-jährigen Jubiläums der Musikschule Reina Sofía in Madrid, Spanien, tourte das Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet durch Europa. Dieses Konzert wurde an der Franz-Liszt-Musikakademie in Budapest, Ungarn, aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Werke für Violine und Klavier: Corelli, Ravel u.a
classica.us.description: Der japanische Geiger Naoya Nishimura und der italienische Pianist Andrea Bacchetti präsentieren ein intimes Recital, das in der Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan, aufgenommen wurde. Diese Aufführung wurde am 22. Juni 2019 aufgenommen.

classica.us.title: Klavierwerke von Bruckner
classica.us.description: Der litauische Pianist Wadim Chaimowitsch spielt Klavierkonzerte von Anton Bruckner.

classica.us.title: Vokale Barockwerke von Cavalli, Strozzi und Bembo
classica.us.description: Der argentinische Dirigent und Cembalist Leonardo García Alarcón führt sein Ensemble Cappella Mediterranea durch ein Programm italienischer Barockmusik. Das Ensemble spielt einige der schönsten Barockstücke von Francesco Cavalli.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Violinkonzert und Sinfonie Nr. 1
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Christian Zacharias leitet das Orchestre National de Lille in einem Schumann-Konzert. Das Konzert beginnt mit der "Genoveva"-Ouvertüre, Op. 81, obwohl Schumanns einzige Oper Genoveva nicht oft aufgeführt wird.

classica.us.title: Mahler - 4. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Kirill Karabits dirigiert Gustav Mahlers 4. Sinfonie. Als Solistin tritt die Sopranistin Lucy Crowe auf. Seine Vierte Sinfonie beginnt mit Schellenklang, Vogelgezwitscher und einer Melodie, wie direkt aus Mozarts Welt. Alles wirkt wunderbar einfach.

classica.us.title: Europakonzert 2013 aus Prag
classica.us.description: Ralph Vaughan Williams: "Fantasia on a Theme by Thomas Tallis" - Antonín Dvořák: Biblische Lieder op. 99 - Ludwig van Beethoven: Symphonie Nr. 6 F-Dur op. 68 "Pastorale". Magdalena Kožená (Mezzosopran), Berliner Philharmoniker, Leitung: Simon Rattle.

classica.us.title: Brahms - Klavierquartett Nr. 3 in c-Moll, Op. 60
classica.us.description: Im Rahmen dieses Konzerterlebnisses spielen der Geiger Tedi Papavrami, die Bratschistin Lyda Chen-Argerich, der Cellist Mischa Maisky und die Pianistin Lily Maisky zusammen Johannes Brahms' Klavierquartett Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 60.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 1 in D-Dur, 'Titan'
classica.us.description: Das Maggio Musicale Fiorentino ist das älteste Opernfestival Italiens. Der Maestro Daniel Harding übernimmt das Dirigieren in einem wunderbaren Konzertprogramm mit der tragischen Ouvertüre in d-Moll, Op. 81 von Johannes Brahms.

classica.us.title: Hommage an Hans van Manen
classica.us.description: Der Sender bietet Ihnen diese Hommage an Hans van Manen mit dem niederländischen Nationalballett.

classica.us.title: Johan de Meij: Echoes of San Marco & Fellini
classica.us.description: Dieses Konzert ist die Frucht der Kooperation der Konservatorien Giuseppe Nicolini in Piacenza und Giuseppe Verdi in Mailand. Auf dem Programm stehen Werke des niederländischen Dirigenten und Komponisten Johan de Meij.

classica.us.title: Strauss - Klavierquartett in c-Moll, op. 13
classica.us.description: Der Geiger Daniel Rowland, die Bratschistin Rachel Roberts, der Cellist Julian Arp und die Pianistin Diana Ketler spielen Richard Strauss' Klavierquartett in c-Moll, Op. 13, beim Stiftfestival 2016 im niederländischen Dorf Weerselo.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - Violinkonzert, op. 35
classica.us.description: Simone Lamsma spielt mit dem London Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von Gianandrea Noseda Pjotr Tschaikowskis Violinkonzert in D-Dur. Bei diesem Konzert aus der Londoner Barbican Hall entfacht Lamsma ein virtuoses Feuer.

classica.us.title: Hollywood-Gala - Preisverleihungsnacht
classica.us.description: Das Dänische Nationale Sinfonieorchester und der Konzertchor entführen Sie auf eine musikalische Reise durch die größten Oscar-prämierten Filme.

classica.us.title: Ginandrea Noseda
classica.us.description: Dieser Dokumentarfilm berichtet über den italienischen Dirigenten Gianandrea Noseda.

classica.us.title: Thomas - Hamlet
classica.us.description: Hamlet ist eine Oper des französischen Komponisten Ambroise Thomas (1811-1896) nach einem Libretto von Michel Carré und Jules Barbier. Die Oper basiert auf der französischen Adaption von Shakespeares Hamlet von Alexandre Dumas und Paul Meurice.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26
classica.us.description: Die Sendung zeigt eine Aufführung von Schumanns "Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26". (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-12-12

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
classica.us.description: Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um den Zyklus "Das Lied von der Erde" von Gustav Mahler zu Gehör zu bringen. Das Konzert fand am 9. Mai 2021 im Barbican Centre in London statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-12-06

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 8. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in F-Dur Op. 93, welche in den Jahren 1812 und 1813 geschrieben wurde und im Jahr 1814 ihre Erstaufführung feierte. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-04-02

(Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment) - 2019

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lots of Muddy Puddles

nickjrtoo.uk.title: The Adventures of Paddington - Paddington's Puffling Rescue; Paddington Goes Under the Sea

10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E5 Inspired by Pol Pot Contestants collect objects that can't talk, hunt for unsolicited quacks, teach the Taskmaster a thing or two, roast some friends, and tackle a studio task with tennis balls and suits.

10shakeperth.au.title: Catfish
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E14 Aaliyah & Alicia Aaliyah has been able to share her life struggles with girlfriend Alicia. However, despite living blocks away, Alicia refuses to meet Aaliyah since she hasn't come out to her friends and family yet.

10shakeperth.au.title: Catfish
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E15 Nick & Melissa Nick and Melissa fell in love when they met on an online when they were 12. Now 18, Nick is ready to finally ready to meet Melissa. But is Melissa the real deal or has Nick been entangled in lies?

10shakeperth.au.title: Ink Master
10shakeperth.au.description: S16 E4 Inked In Gold Teams turn trash into treasure, leading to a shocking elimination.

10shakeperth.au.title: Invader Zim
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E17 Megadoomer / Lice ZIM gets sent a cool robot from Irk. / The school is hit with an infestation of lice and a visit from the Delouser!

10shakeperth.au.title: Hey Arnold!
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E13 Arnold The Tutor / Gerald Comes Over Torvald, the meanest kid in Arnold's math class, needs a tutor for the big test, and guess who gets the assignment! // Arnold lets Gerald spend the night in the boarding house.

10shakeperth.au.title: T.U.F.F Puppy
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E1 Pup Daddy / Candy Cane-Ine Dudley accidentally hits the other TUFF agents with a Young Gun, they turn into younger versions of themselves. // Willy Wombat, the greatest candy maker, asks if TUFF's agents can break in to his factory to test his new security system.

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E1 Call A Clambulance When Oona's friend Avi breaks a bone in his tail, he needs to visit the doctor. The Bubble Guppies aren't too worried after they learn that it's a doctor's job to make everyone feel better.

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E2 The Crayon Prix Green means GO! The Bubble Guppies are learning about colours while car racing! Help them mix colours, make new shades, and speed across the finish line!

10shakeperth.au.title: The Tiny Chef Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E6 Apple Pie/guacamole Tiny Chef bakes apple pie for the big contest, after an accident has to think fast to come up with a new entry. // Tiny Chef makes guacamole and has to learn to share when his friends want to help.

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E22 Dreams And Nightmares Sofi wakes up in the middle of the night because she had a nightmare. Lara and Margarita help her understand that it is only her story in her imagination, nothing bad will happen to her.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E14 Trouble At The Truck Wash When an overeager Crusher use extra soap and causes the Truck Wash to explode out into Axle City, Blaze and friends will need help using angles to recover the pieces and get the trucks clean again!

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E17 Cattle Drive When Blaze and Starla encounter a herd of cows wandering out in the desert, they must embark on a wild west adventure to bring them back to Starla's barn.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E15 Pups Chill Out / Pups Save Farmer Alex The pups try to save frozen puppy pops from Roger's van after it gets stuck in a ditch during a heatwave. The Tour de Turbot is put in jeopardy when stampeding farm animals threaten the event.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E16 Sea Patrol: Pups Save A Shark / Pups Save The Pier Hoping to have the whole of Adventure Beach to himself, Humdinger makes a robotic shark to scare everyone away. Francois sculpts a statue of himself using jelly, attracting hungry animals to the pier.

10shakeperth.au.title: Dora
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E4 Big Red Chicken Wake Up! / The Mystery Gift Dora and Boots have to wake up the Big Red Chicken before he floats over a waterfall! // Dora and friends must solve a series of questions and challenges to open a mysterious gift.

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E22 Findependence Day / Costello Quits Fishy Force takes on a villain who steals all the treats in Carnivore Cove. // When Costello quits, Vigo sets out to be a supervillain without his henchfishy.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E18 Dragon Island Duel Blaze and Crusher prepare for a special one-on-one race around Dragon Island, but Crusher gets Blaze to miss the start of the race, so AJ rushes to find Blaze and bring him back to the starting line.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E16 Runaway Rocket When Crusher tries to cheat at a carnival game, he accidentally strands himself and Pickle on a giant rocket! Now it's up to Blaze and AJ to rescue the trucks before their runaway rocket crashes.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S7 E18 Pups Save Little Hairy/pups Save A Kooky Klimber Big Hairy's little brother falls into a hole and Tracker gets carried away by Big Hairy. It's time for a Jungle Rescue! // Daring Danny tries extreme rock climbing with Ace Sorenson. It's up to the Paw Patrol to save the duo.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol

10shakeperth.au.title: Unicorn Academy

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble and Crew (Double Episode)

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E3 Bubble Puppy Gil wants to adopt a puppy! But before he can bring the puppy home, the Bubble Guppies must learn how to take care of pets.

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E4 Build Me A Building! It's going to be the best doghouse EVER! But before Bubble Puppy can move into his new doggy digs, the Bubble Guppies are going to need help building it, while discovering all about construction.

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E3 Dollhouse Safari Gabby, Pandy and their curious crew set out on an animal safari. Can they work together to find a mysterious creature? Let the adventure begin.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Tiny Chef Show

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
